title: पञ्चसप्तत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Janamejaya asks how mighty Bhima came to fear a python. While hunting, Bhima is seized by a huge python and, to his amazement, cannot free himself in spite of all his strength.
summary.kn: ಮಹಾಬಲಿ ಭೀಮನು ಹೆಬ್ಬಾವಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೆದರಿದನೆಂದು ಜನಮೇಜಯನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬೇಟೆಯಾಡುವಾಗ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹೆಬ್ಬಾವು ಭೀಮನನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಬಲಹಾಕಿದರೂ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬಿಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗದೆ ಬೆರಗಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: जनमेजय पूछते हैं कि महाबली भीम अजगर से कैसे डरे। शिकार करते समय एक विशाल अजगर भीम को पकड़ लेता है, और वे आश्चर्य से पाते हैं कि अपने सारे बल से भी स्वयं को छुड़ा नहीं पा रहे।
summary.te: మహాబలుడైన భీముడు కొండచిలువకు ఎలా భయపడ్డాడని జనమేజయుడు అడుగుతాడు. వేటాడుతుండగా పెద్ద కొండచిలువ భీముని పట్టుకుంటుంది, ఎంత బలం ప్రయోగించినా విడిపించుకోలేక అతడు ఆశ్చర్యపోతాడు.
summary.ta: வலிமைமிக்க பீமன் மலைப்பாம்புக்கு எப்படி அஞ்சினான் என்று ஜனமேஜயன் கேட்கிறான். வேட்டையாடும்போது ஒரு பெரிய மலைப்பாம்பு பீமனைப் பற்றிக்கொள்ள, முழு வலிமையையும் செலுத்தியும் விடுபட முடியாமல் அவன் வியக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ഭീമന് പെരുമ്പാമ്പിനെ ഭയം വന്നതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് ജനമേജയൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. വേട്ടയ്ക്കിടെ ഭീമനെ ഒരു വലിയ പെരുമ്പാമ്പ് പിടികൂടുന്നു; എല്ലാ ബലമുണ്ടായിട്ടും സ്വയം മോചിതനാകാനാകാതെ ഭീമൻ അത്ഭുതപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.175; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
कथं नागायुतप्राणो भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
भयमाहारयत्तीव्रं तस्मादजगरान्मुने ॥

meaning.en: How did mighty Bhimasena, who had the strength of ten thousand elephants, come to feel sharp fear of that python, sage?

verses.text:
पौलस्त्यं योऽऽह्वयद्युद्धे धनदं बलदर्पितः ।
नलिन्यां कदनं कृत्वा वराणां यक्षरक्षसाम् ॥

meaning.en: He was the one who, proud of his strength, challenged in battle Kubera the giver of wealth, descendant of Pulastya, after he had slaughtered the best yakshas and rakshasas at the lotus pond.

verses.text:
तं शंससि भयाविष्टमापन्नमरिकर्षणम् ।
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥

meaning.en: You say that he, tormentor of foes, fell into distress and was seized by fear. I wish to hear this, for my curiosity is very great.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
बह्वाश्चर्ये वने तेषां वसतामुग्रधन्विनाम् ।
प्राप्तानामाश्रमाद्राजन्राजर्षेर्वृषपर्वणः ॥

meaning.en: While those fierce archers were living in the forest, which held many wonders, after they came from the hermitage of the royal sage Vrishaparvan, O king,

verses.text:
यदृच्छया धनुष्पाणिर्बद्धखड्गो वृकोदरः ।
ददर्श तद्वनं रम्यं देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, bow in hand and sword at his side, by chance came to see that lovely forest frequented by gods and gandharvas.

verses.text:
स ददर्श शुभान्देशान्गिरेर्हिमवतस्तदा ।
देवर्षिसिद्धचरितानप्सरोगणसेवितान् ॥

meaning.en: He saw the fair regions of the Himalaya mountain, visited by divine sages and siddhas and served by hosts of apsaras.

verses.text:
चकोरैश्चक्रवाकैश्च पक्षिभिर्जीवजीवकैः ।
कोकिलैर्भृङ्गराजैश्च तत्र तत्र विनादितान् ॥

meaning.en: They resounded here and there with chakoras, chakravakas, jivajivaka birds, cuckoos and bhringarajas.

verses.text:
नित्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैर्हिमसंस्पर्शकोमलैः ।
उपेतान्बहुलच्छायैर्मनोनयननन्दनैः ॥

meaning.en: They were full of trees that always bore flowers and fruit, tender to the touch of frost, with thick shade, pleasing to mind and eye.

verses.text:
स संपश्यन्गिरिनदीर्वैडूर्यमणिसंनिभैः ।
सलिलैर्हिमसंस्पर्शैर्हंसकारण्डवायुतैः ॥

meaning.en: He saw the mountain streams with waters like lapis lazuli, cold to the touch, filled with swans and karandavas.

verses.text:
वनानि देवदारूणां मेघानामिव वागुराः ।
हरिचन्दनमिश्राणि तुङ्गकालीयकान्यपि ॥

meaning.en: He saw forests of deodar, like nets for the clouds, and tall kaliyaka trees mixed with yellow sandal.

verses.text:
मृगयां परिधावन्स समेषु मरुधन्वसु ।
विध्यन्मृगाञ्शरैः शुद्धैश्चचार सुमहाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Chasing game over the level desert-like ground, the very strong Bhima roamed, piercing deer with clean arrows.

verses.text:
स ददर्श महाकायं भुजङ्गं लोमहर्षणम् ।
गिरिदुर्गे समापन्नं कायेनावृत्य कन्दरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then he saw a hair-raising serpent of huge body lying in a mountain defile, blocking a cave with its coils.

verses.text:
पर्वताभोगवर्ष्माणं भोगैश्चन्द्रार्कमण्डलैः ।
चित्राङ्गमजिनैश्चित्रैर्हरिद्रासदृशच्छविम् ॥

meaning.en: Its body was like a mountain mass, its coils like the discs of the moon and sun, its limbs variegated with spots like deer-skins and its color like turmeric.

verses.text:
गुहाकारेण वक्त्रेण चतुर्दंष्ट्रेण राजता ।
दीप्ताक्षेणातिताम्रेण लिहन्तं सृक्किणी मुहुः ॥

meaning.en: It had a cave-like mouth with four fangs, a bright, coppery red one, with blazing eyes, and it kept licking the corners of its mouth.

verses.text:
त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां कालान्तकयमोपमम् ।
निःश्वासक्ष्वेडनादेन भर्त्सयन्तमिव स्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: Terrifying to all beings, like Death, the ender and Yama, it seemed to threaten with the hissing sound of its breath.

verses.text:
स भीमं सहसाभ्येत्य पृदाकुः क्षुधितो भृशम् ।
जग्राहाजगरो ग्राहो भुजयोरुभयोर्बलात् ॥

meaning.en: Suddenly the starving python, a ravenous creature, rushed on Bhima and by force seized him by both arms.

verses.text:
तेन संस्पृष्टमात्रस्य भीमसेनस्य वै तदा ।
संज्ञा मुमोह सहसा वरदानेन तस्य ह ॥

meaning.en: The moment the serpent touched Bhimasena, his senses suddenly reeled, through a boon the serpent had.

verses.text:
दश नागसहस्राणि धारयन्ति हि यद्बलम् ।
तद्बलं भीमसेनस्य भुजयोरसमं परैः ॥

meaning.en: For the strength of ten thousand elephants that Bhimasena held in his arms was incomparable among others.

verses.text:
स तेजस्वी तथा तेन भुजगेन वशीकृतः ।
विस्फुरञ्शनकैर्भीमो न शशाक विचेष्टितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Yet that mighty one, mastered by that snake, writhed slowly and could not move about.

verses.text:
नागायुतसमप्राणः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः ।
गृहीतो व्यजहात्सत्त्वं वरदानेन मोहितः ॥

meaning.en: Though he had the strength of ten thousand elephants, with lion shoulders and mighty arms, once seized he lost his vigor, stupefied by the boon.

verses.text:
स हि प्रयत्नमकरोत्तीव्रमात्मविमोक्षणे ।
न चैनमशकद्वीरः कथंचित्प्रतिबाधितुम् ॥

meaning.en: He made a fierce effort to free himself, but the hero could not in any way fight it off.
